Scales how long bees stay angry after you disturb or crack open hives and nests. 1.0 = current, 0 = they calm down almost immediately, 2.0 = twice as long.
When off, angry bees are still shown but never sting - no health damage, poison or swelling. For relaxed servers.
Bee and larvae growth per cycle
Scales how many bees and larvae each production cycle adds. 1.0 = current, 2.0 = double. Kept separate from honeycomb so honey and colony can be tuned apart.
At or below this temperature the bees hibernate and the hive stops. 7 = current. Lower it for hardier bees, raise it for a shorter season.

Extra production while a hive is fed, on top of the forage the sugar water stands in for. 1.15 = 15%% faster, 1.0 = no bonus at all (the forage rescue still applies). Rain, snow and freezing still stop the hive no matter how well fed it is.
Sugar water: working hours per litre

How many working hours one litre of stored sugar water buys. 24 = a full day of work per litre. The bees only drink while they are actually working, so a hive halted by rain or frost loses nothing from its supply. A hive holding any sugar water forages as if there were an ordinary spread of flowers around it - enough to keep working through winter or a poor biome, but no better than a decent summer.
How fast a working hive fills its comb and grows. 1.0 = current pacing, 2.0 = twice as fast, 0.5 = half speed. Weather, temperature, flowers and feeding still apply on top.
Scales how many filled combs each production cycle adds. 1.0 = current (2-4), 2.0 = double. The hive still holds no more than its cells.
Jars left out sour into yeast after (hours)

A jar of sugar water or honey left on the ground away from any hive turns into a Wild Yeast Starter after this many hours. 48 = current (two days). 0 = never. Jars within reach of a hive are drunk by the bees instead and never sour.
Scales how fast mead barrels ferment through Young, Normal, Aged (and Spoiled). 1.0 = current pacing, 2.0 = twice as fast, 0.5 = half speed. Applies to batches already fermenting.
When disabled, a batch left too long holds at Aged quality forever instead of turning Spoiled.
Chance a harvest that collects honeycomb also yields propolis. 0.30 = current (30%%), 0 = never, 1.0 = always.

Scales how often Queen Bees appear while foraging, in every zone. 1.0 = default scarcity (roughly one queen per 2-5 in-game hours of daytime foraging in forest zones, in season Apr-Oct, none Dec-Mar). 2.0 = about twice as common. 0 = queens never appear from foraging.
How long placed queen larvae take to become a new queen. 48 = current (two days).
How many days a queen lays before she needs replacing. 7 = current. Longer games may want 14-30. Applies to queens inserted or raised after the change.
How long a full, queenless hive takes to make royal jelly. 72 = current (three days).
Scales how long a bee smoker keeps a hive calm. 1.0 = current, 2.0 = smoke lasts twice as long.
